TGB should be tracked as a small/mid-cap acid-dependent copper SX/EW producer; next layer must verify acid procurement and reagent cost sensitivity.

summary: Layer 1B expanded the US-listed universe around the sulphur/sulphuric-acid feedstock node with an underfollowed lens. The most relevant discovery candidates are not copper or nickel mega-cap leaders, but smaller chemical distributors, acid-dependent copper leach projects, fertilizer producers with sulfur cost exposure, and bulk-liquid logistics providers that could become capacity gates if acid movements reroute. Candidates are research leads only, not investment recommendations.
